eps.ov: Yu Ayase transfers to a school for prodigies—but despite his gifted mother, he's perfectly mediocre.
Tasked with looking out for the sisters, Yu tries to win them over—through their stomachs.

eps.t: I Want Us to Be a Family
eps.ov: Yu begins to get to know the three sisters, and they start to see him as more than just an unwelcome guest.

eps.t: A Memory the Sisters Can Share
eps.ov: Yu carries out his plan to have the sisters enjoy the Cherry Blossom Night Festival together.
The three sisters grow closer after the festival... and then their father comes home.
As Kazuki prepares for her most challenging role yet, she asks Yu on a date to get in the mindset.

eps.t: You Will Win No Matter What
eps.ov: Yu throws himself into intense training with Niko's help, preparing for his one-on-one showdown with Hayato.
Niko wins the battle against Hayato, so she says to Yu “I’ll grant you any wish” for doing his best for her.
Yu delivers Miwa's forgotten lunch during her shogi game. Touched, she asks him to have lunch with her.
Kazuki and Niko try to console Miwa, but she gets angry and runs out of the house. Yu goes to look for her.
Miwa faces off against Sakura now imbued with focus and determination.
